name: Career
author: Sixth Front
description: Built into the game and always on: a War Thunder style career. Winning battles pays research points (RP) and silver (SL) (a loss pays a quarter; the big naval and aviation battles pay more); the after-action report shows what you earned. In the HANGAR (main menu or deploy screen) research ships, aircraft and guns with RP, one after another down each tree, then buy them with silver: only what you own can be taken into battle (you start with a patrol boat, an F-16C or MiG-29 and the standard guns). Owned ships and aircraft take modifications you research, buy and switch on: reinforced hull, turbines, rudder, gun loading drill, fast rearming, Phalanx Block 1B, damage control training, spall liners; engine tuning, airframe, controls, extra flares. New guns to unlock: AK-12, SCAR-H, MP5A3, KRISS Vector, Remington 870, M249 SAW, PKP Pecheneg, Mk 14 EBR, AWM, Glock 17, Desert Eagle.

.cr-wrap { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.cr-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 10px; }
.cr-bank div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; }
.cr-bank span { font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.cr-bank b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.35rem; color: var(--signal); }
.cr-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

.cr-seg button { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; font-size: 0.74rem; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
.cr-seg button.on { border-color: var(--signal); color: var(--signal); background: rgba(242,179,61,0.1); }
.cr-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; align-items: stretch; }
.cr-row > h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--muted); align-self: center; }
.cr-chain { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }

.cr-card { flex: 0 0 200px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; color: var(--text); font: inherit; position: relative; }
.cr-card .cr-rank { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); }
.cr-card small { font-size: 0.64rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.cr-st.own { color: var(--squad); } .cr-st.buy { color: var(--signal); } .cr-st.res { color: #7fd0ff; } .cr-st.no { color: var(--muted); }
.cr-detail { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.cr-detail p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.45; }
.cr-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.cr-mods { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.cr-mod { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cr-mod div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.cr-mod i { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); }

.cr-mod button, .cr-actions button.cr-act { flex: 0 0 auto; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 6px 9px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.cr-msg { min-height: 1.2em; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--signal); }
.cr-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 10px; }
.cr-foot p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 760px; line-height: 1.4; }
#cr-rewards { margin: 10px 0 4px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(242,179,61,0.4); background: rgba(242,179,61,0.06); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

#cr-rewards ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: 0.74rem; }

.btn .cr-btn-sl { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.78rem; margin-left: 8px; opacity: 0.8; letter-spacing: 0; }
